# Rust

Standards stay the bar. Numbers live in the copied files, not here.

If the Makefile has `check`, `.helmsman/tools/checks/delegate-gate.sh` runs it. A root `package.json` `check` script is that same delegate when `make check` is absent. `lint` runs when that is the only Makefile gate. Do not add a second `clippy.toml`. `.helmsman/tools/checks/rust-workspace.sh` still runs when the consumer script omits `cargo fmt` and clippy. Do not replace `[workspace.lints]` or `[lints]`. `.helmsman/tools/clippy/floor.sh` skips those copies. The numbers are a floor. Do not raise them.

`.helmsman/tools/checks/rust-workspace.sh` runs only when neither target exists. `unsafe_code` is forbid. `clippy::all` is deny. Pedantic is warn. Deny `unwrap_used`, `expect_used`, `panic`, `todo`, `unimplemented`, `allow_attributes_without_reason`, `cognitive_complexity`, `too_many_lines`, `too_many_arguments`, and `type_complexity`. Thresholds: cognitive complexity 15, function lines 50, arguments 6, type complexity 250. Nursery stays off.

rustfmt edition is 2024. The toolchain channel is stable. `rust-version` is 1.85.

File length is a separate script: 500 lines, every tracked `.rs` file. Copy it to `scripts/check-file-length.sh` and call it from `make lines` only when that target is absent.

An allow attribute on an added line fails the diff guard. The shared deny file has no license allow-list.
